lines.text: You know it's crazy
I woke up this morning
To grace and mercy
That just keep on flowing
My heart is beating
My eyes are wide open
Thank You Lord
It's so amazing
That someone so perfect
Would show me love
When I didn't deserve it
You gave Your life just
To show me I'm worth it
lines.text_sk: Aby si mi ukázal, že za to stojím

lines.text: Thank You Lord

It's history
It's a miracle
What You did for me
Thank You Lord
You made a way
I saw a mountain
And I watched You move it
